description: Build a day by day study plan for one or more exams. Give each exam date and the hours you have per day, and get dated study sessions split by urgency, with a warning when the hours do not fit. Example prompt: "Plan 3 weeks of study for my 4 exams, 90 minutes a day."

exams.description: Exams with name, date and optional hours needed.

hours_needed.description: Study hours you want to put in. Defaults to 10.

hours_per_day.description: Study hours available on a study day.

start_date.description: First day to study. Defaults to today.

name: build_study_plan
title: Build a study plan
